general.name: Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything

general.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
general.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.

general.name: apple/container
general.description: A tool for creating and running Linux containers using lightweight virtual machines on a Mac. It is written in Swift, and optimized for Apple silicon.

general.name: colbymchenry/codegraph
general.description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto syncs on code changes, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, and Hermes Agent — fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local

general.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.

general.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop

提供频道数据 database 与 API 供查询调用

general.name: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
general.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork

每个 plugin 集成对应职能的 skills、connectors、slash commands 和 sub-agents

可按公司工具、术语、流程自定义，使 Claude 适配团队

general.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
general.description: OpenAI-compatible proxy that stacks the free tiers of 16 LLM providers (~1.7B tokens/month) behind one /v1 endpoint — plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
general.description_zh: OpenAI 兼容代理，将 16 个 LLM 提供商的免费额度（约 17 亿 tokens/月）整合到一个 /v1 端点，并支持任意自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点。智能路由、自动故障转移、密钥加密。仅供个人实验使用。

router 自动选择最佳模型并在限流时故障转移到下一个 provider

支持自定义 OpenAI 兼容 endpoint，如 llama.cpp、LM Studio、vLLM、Ollama

general.name: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
general.description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.

单一静态二进制文件，零依赖，跨 macOS/Linux/Windows

ai.description_zh: 让你的 AI agent 拥有洞察整个互联网的双眼。读取并搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书——一个 CLI，零 API 费用。
features: 一键为 AI Agent 接入互联网，自动选装并健康检查接入方式
支持网页、YouTube、Twitter、Reddit、小红书、B站、GitHub、RSS 等多平台读取
每个平台采用首选+备选多后端路由，接入失效自动换代
兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等任意命令行 Agent
内置 doctor 诊断命令，一键检测各接入状态并给出修复建议

ai.name: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
ai.description: 754 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents · Mapped to 5 frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND & NIST AI RMF · agentskills.io standard · Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI & 20+ platforms · 26 security domains · Apache 2.0
ai.description_zh: 面向 AI agent 的 754 项结构化网络安全技能 · 对标 5 大框架：MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF 2.0、MITRE ATLAS、D3FEND 和 NIST AI RMF · 遵循 agentskills.io 标准 · 兼容 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot、Codex CLI、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 20+ 平台 · 涵盖 26 个安全领域 · Apache 2.0
features: 提供 754 个生产级 cybersecurity skills，覆盖 26 个安全领域
为 AI agent 赋予资深安全分析师的能力与知识
兼容 26+ AI 平台，含 Hermes Agent 等
映射 5 大主流安全 framework，统一技能标准
遵循 agentskills.io 开放标准，支持社区贡献

ai.name: ogulcancelik/herdr
ai.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
ai.description_zh: 终端中运行的 agent 多路复用器。
features: 在终端中运行的 agent multiplexer，无需 GUI 或 Electron
支持 workspaces、tabs、panes，并提供 mouse-native 的点击拖拽分屏操作
可 detach 和 reattach，agent 在后台持续运行
一目了然查看每个 agent 状态：blocked、working、done
提供 socket API 及多种 integrations 集成支持
